verdict.rationale: Next.js documents ways to shrink client JavaScript: Server Components add UI without extra client-side JS, a Bundle Analyzer helps optimize client bundles, and a community report confirms automatic per-route code splitting. Nothing in the evidence shows a dependency-light client runtime or any supply-chain risk reduction. missing for 10: evidence of a small baseline framework runtime, dependency-light or minimal-dependency footprint, supply-chain risk controls, independent bundle-size measurements.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship a small, dependency-light client bundle to minimize runtime footprint and reduce supply-chain risk

citations.quote: Add components without sending additional client-side JavaScript.
Learn how to analyze and optimize your application's server and client bundles with the Next.js Bundle Analyzer for Turbopack
